answer: Beacon-gated commit-reveal admission resists sybils. Each identity posts a 2.00-unit escrow and hash commitment at epoch E; a VRF beacon at E+2 sets an admission ridge: only commitments with hash mod 100 below 10 activate. The admission trellis logs each commitment and epoch; winners reveal within 5 epochs or burn the escrow, losers refund 1.75 and burn 0.25. An attacker wanting 100 sybils pre-commits ~1000 identities: 2000 units locked, ~225 burned on failed windows, each retry burns 0.25 more per identity; the epoch atlas makes every event auditable.
